title: Nick Sirianni on Hollywood Brown: We want to get him on field, didn't work out Sunday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Sirianni on Hollywood Brown: We want to get him on field, didn't work out Sunday
sources.description: Wide receiver Hollywood Brown was active for Sunday's game, but the veteran never got on the field during the Eagles' 24-22 win over the Commanders.
